title: Balance Link Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid of white cells, black cells and symbols. Identical symbols are joined in pairs by lines through cell centres; each line is mirror-symmetric about its midpoint.

cells.description: m x n grid. 0 = white cell, 1 = black cell, otherwise a symbol: tens digit = shape (1 circle, 2 square, 3 diamond, 4 triangle up, 5 triangle down, 6 five-point star, 7 four-point star), ones digit = colour (0 white/outlined, 1 black/filled).
